_doc: Batch m02 (medium creatures, sonnet generic pass). Same format as overrides.json.

leafcutter-column/f:b0.note: jaw nip on a leaf piece: bite (best guess vs leaf, the column is leaf-heavy already)

leafcutter-column/f:u3.note: green parade of carried leaf pieces: leaf, identity of the creature

leafcutter-column/f:b3.note: scatter of the column: dust puffs, so it differs from March On (shock)

army-ant-column/f:u0.note: wall of jaws bristling; differs from Flank Slip (both were puff)

army-ant-column/f:b3.note: flow around obstacles: ripple runs, differs from the shock trick family

paper-wasp/f:b0.note: short jab: thrust so it differs from Striped Lunge (both were slash)

hornet-sentry/f:b0.note: dive-bombing hornet: buzz, differs from Night-Watch Strike (both were slash)

hornet-sentry/f:b3.note: blossom snub: leaf petals instead of generic shock

hornet-sentry/f:u2.note: paper wall of the nest: papery strands, differs from Door Bar (both shield)

mud-dauber/f:b2.note: plastered mud blocks: bash, differs from Mud Plaster (both shield)

mud-dauber/f:b3.note: rain dodge: rain ripples instead of generic shock

lantern-glowworm-queen/f:b2.note: rule 4 order: lamp keyword (sparkle) before web; the lamp is the creature identity

lantern-glowworm-queen/f:b3.note: bait dangling on threads: web strands

earwig-matron/f:u3.note: soft egg cushion: puffs, differs from Brood Tend (both mend); heal override, best guess

luna-moth/f:b1.note: gust of wind: puffs, differs from Ribbon Sweep (both slash)

luna-moth/f:u0.note: moonlit veil: shimmer sparkles, differs from Trailing Tails/Gust puffs

luna-moth/f:u1.note: long trailing tails drifting: leaf-drift ribbons (best guess)
